description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class and associated audio buffer handling functions used for voice activation and recognition. It manages microphone permissions, starts/stops speech recognition sessions, handles audio buffers, and detects trigger words from speech input.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue for managing AVAudioPCMBuffer instances during speech recognition.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake word detection, speech recognition, and command handling, including microphone permission management and recognition pipeline control.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback to enqueue audio buffers into the AudioBufferQueue.

methods.name: AudioBufferQueue.enqueueCopy
methods.description: Adds a deep-copied audio buffer into the queue in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: AudioBufferQueue.drain
methods.description: Removes and returns all buffers from the queue.

methods.name: AudioBufferQueue.clear
methods.description: Clears all buffers from the queue.

methods.name: AVAudioPCMBuffer.deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the audio buffer by copying its channel data.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition process, managing permissions and audio setup.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.stop
methods.description: Stops recognition and disables voice wake features.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.suspendForExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Temporarily suspends voice wake listening for external audio capture.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.resumeAfterExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Resumes recognition after external audio capture was suspended.

methods.name: VoiceWakeManager.setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the voice wake feature.
